dialogues.speaker: Aryadeva
dialogues.text: I haven't studied in the Akademiya, but I'd like to consider myself a Herbad in the field of light novels.

dialogues.speaker: Aryadeva
dialogues.text: However, there is no school in the Akademiya that awards diplomas in light novels.

dialogues.speaker: Aryadeva
dialogues.text: That's why it's pertinent to have my book published by Yae Publishing House. My book's title is "Can a Trainee Combat Mage Whose Normal Attack Summons a Jinni that Will Start a Full-Out Free-For-All Really Graduate From the Magic Akademiya?"

dialogues.speaker: Aryadeva
dialogues.text: I didn't expect my manuscript to be rejected again. Those Yae Publishing House editors are really strict...
